static_observations.result: capability_grant has authenticated SELECT RLS scoped by current_clinic_ids(); the base table policy is not inherited by v_quyen_hieu_luc under a normal owner-rights view definition.

v_quyen_hieu_luc and v_quyen_thuc_te are granted to authenticated without security_invoker or explicit tenant filtering. v_quyen_thuc_te reads schedule/room data; its schedule helper EXECUTE grants are absent from the final authenticated whitelist.

Targeted identity, clinical-role and staff-assignment SECURITY DEFINER helper definitions use an explicit public, pg_temp search_path, caller identity/active membership, and role or assignment predicates; no distinct candidate identified in this slice.
The final migration removes anon/authenticated read privileges and SELECT policies from 11 stock/inventory ledger tables and grants service_role SELECT.

The init SQL declares service_role BYPASSRLS and source comments state FastAPI connects as database owner. RLS is therefore not a backend tenant boundary; backend query predicates and authorization remain required.

validation.result: Reviewed migration definitions, RLS policies, function ACL changes and relevant SQL tests by source inspection. No database/runtime behavior was exercised.

limitations: The supplied snapshot export has no .git directory; exact SHA is pinned by the task and independently confirmed by the orchestrator against its repository.
No production migration ledger, actual view owner, role attributes, grants catalog or data rows were inspected.
SEC-017's earlier read-only CI EXPLAIN evidence is referenced only for deduplication; this round did not rerun it.
